evals.prompt: A client supplied a repository, exact one-file copy change, acceptance screenshot, two-day deadline, fixed budget, and one revision. Decide whether to accept.
evals.expected_output: A compact direct-take posture and client-ready acceptance reply.
expectations: Chooses take when the evidence is sufficient.
Does not manufacture discovery or decline.

evals.prompt: A broken payment app has no tests or credentials and needs production deployment tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: A full paid-discovery, staged, hourly, reshape, or decline assessment.
expectations: Uses full output only because risk is high.

evals.prompt: A small client change is clear except who approves acceptance.
evals.expected_output: A standard or minimal response asking the one quote-changing question.
expectations: Includes posture, basis, and client-ready reply.
